title: Support Libre Pro sensors
body: Hi.. am using the xdrip+ latest nightly build and trying to connect to a libre pro sensor with a BluCon. But every time after I do the initial calibration, xdrip gives a flat line of bg values i.e. the same value I calibrated with  What could I be doing wrong?

I'm in India. The sensor works for 14 days, it's meant for healthcare professionals to assess patient values, and is the only libre available here. Have been getting readings on the BluCon app but not on the xdrip.

I'm not sure xDrip supports the indian sensors. Does it work for other people in India?
Does it work when scanning it with the phone?
I'm not sure it works for other people as I don't know anyone else using it right now. It does work with scanning with Glimp and it works on the LinkBluCon app. I just wanted to use it with xdrip....

@ipsita1917 You can ask in the support channels.
Many more frequent those and you have a better chance of finding a solution if one exists.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus

@Navid200 copying the feature request 1677 (duplicate) I had submitted. 

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
We notice that Xdrip currently does not support Libre pro sensors. We in India primarily use Libre Pro as our CGM and we are struck with using the Native apps like Tomato (for Miao Miao) and Link Blucon (Ambrosia Blucon). Most of them are happy with the Native apps but with the recent server issues Miao Miao had, we are interested to see a possibility of using these DIY apps. There are hundreds (possibly thousands) who could benefit with this addition.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
We know that Xdrip already supports Libre 1, Libre US 14 day, Libre US 10 day etc.. We would like the similar support for Libre Pro as well

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
At this moment only alternatives we have have are the native apps and they have been unreliable in many times and also providing us limited functionality for those who are interested in DIY Closed loop technologies.

**Additional context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.**
I am on DIY Closed loop using Libre Pro + Tomato + Nightscout. There are few others using exactly the same setup. But with this setup, we can use it only when we are connected to internet. If we could get the Xdrip support Libre Pro sensors, it would be helpful to do closed loop in offline mode as well.

Note that the Freestyle Libre Pro works with the Limitter -> xDrip+.
With the Blucon - suspect it's a data translation issue however I don't have the expertise to fix this. 
Would be really great if xDrip+ worked with the Blucon as Ambrosia's software is horrendous.
Any update available for libre pro support..??
Same question as everyone else. Any update on support for Libre Pro. I can contribute to the feature if anything is required.
